## Advantage - Bonzo INTAKE -> GHL

Bonzo Service/webhook POSTs a new lead here; upserts a GHL contact.

FILL: REPLACE_GHL_LOCATION_ID + the CF field IDs in Normalize.
GHL node: set Header Auth credential (Bearer PIT) for the Advantage subaccount.
Confirm Bonzo's outbound payload keys (leadid/firstname/phone/email).
